# go-modern-slices-index-func

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.IndexFunc to find an element by predicate.

## Details

slices.IndexFunc is the standard predicate-based lookup.
Use it when the match depends on fields, derived values, or any condition other than direct equality.

## Examples

### Before

```go
index := -1
for i, item := range items {
  if item.ID == id {
    index = i
    break
  }
}
```

### After

```go
index := slices.IndexFunc(items, func(item Item) bool {
  return item.ID == id
})
```
